added.name: San Joaquin Delta College
added.why: File page description: 'Dolores Huerta Plaza in the Main Campus'; categories include 'Category:San Joaquin Delta College'. Dolores Huerta Plaza is at San Joaquin Delta College's main campus in Stockton, CA — not Delta College (University Center, MI).

added.name: Ohio State University-Mansfield Campus
added.why: The photo is a joint welcome sign at the shared Mansfield site showing BOTH schools (left panel: 'The Ohio State University', right panel: 'North Central State College', banner: 'Mansfield Campus'); file description reads 'welcome sign at The Ohio State University and North Central State College site in Mansfield, Ohio'. Genuinely depicts both, so this is a reading-order tiebreak: Ohio State is named first in the description and occupies the sign's left (first-read) panel. Flag: either school could legitimately keep it.

added.name: Pontifical Catholic University of Puerto Rico-Ponce
added.why: File page: 'Front view of the Pontifical Catholic University of Puerto Rico main entrance'; filename locates it in Barrio Canas Urbano, Ponce, Puerto Rico; category 'Pontifical Catholic University of Puerto Rico'. This is the Ponce campus arch — kept by PUCPR-Ponce, removed from PUCPR-Mayaguez.
